meta.experiment: Traces-vs-retry ablation (stage 1: N=5/arm signal check) on two_arm_lift
meta.question: Do ASPIRE's per-primitive multimodal traces causally improve repair over a plain reward-driven retry with matched compute?
meta.design: Two arms, single manipulated variable = trace access. T = traces (ablate_traces=false); C = scalar reward only (ablate_traces=true). Both: opus repair, s_dbg [0,1,2], s_val 100-119 (held-out), theta 1.0, debug_rounds 2, evosearch OFF (t=0), empty per-repeat library, pristine baseline md5 0ada19ef. Isolated dirs per repeat.
meta.integrity: Control-arm trace-leak (capx replay raw dir inside actor sandbox) was closed before the run (commit 640a80b). Config logged per run confirms ablate_traces true/false per arm and t=0 both arms.
meta.run_status: COMPLETE, clean — 10/10 runs, no credit failures, no crashes, no tainted runs.

test.statistic: Mann-Whitney U (T vs C), one-sided, tie-corrected normal approx

verdict.direction: Every summary statistic favors traces: mean 0.63 vs 0.37 (+0.26), median 0.90 vs 0.20 (+0.70), P(val>=0.80) 0.60 vs 0.20 (3x).
verdict.significance: NOT significant at N=5 (z=0.949, one-sided p~0.17). The effect direction is consistent and the effect size is moderate-to-large, but N=5 against this variance cannot reject H0.
verdict.pre_registered_read: This is the pre-committed 'ambiguous / underpowered' outcome. Per the spec: do NOT read a null; extend to N=8/arm (then N=16 if still ambiguous). The signal is promising (traces ahead on all three metrics) but not yet a reportable result.
verdict.recommended_next: Extend to N=8/arm (3 more repeats per arm = 6 runs; done repeats are skipped on re-run). Re-run: N=8 bash ~/start_traces_ablation.sh, then re-run scripts/analyze_ablation.py.

notes.val_score_gate_validated_live: The admission gate (commit f306e65) fired correctly in the wild: every repeat with val < 0.5 (T rep_2 0.05, T rep_4 0.30; C rep_2 0.0, C rep_4 0.20, C rep_5 0.05) admitted ZERO skills; only val>=0.5 repeats admitted skills.
notes.evosearch_off_confirmed: t=0 in every logged config; no evosearch_best_* artifacts; winners are Stage-1 debug programs (dbg often < theta, e.g. 0.33/0.67, validated directly).
